Leadership

Company Description

At KPFF Consulting Engineers, we are more than just an engineering design firm. For 65 years, we have dedicated ourselves to innovative, sustainable engineering that shapes the built environment and tackles complex infrastructure challenges. With nearly 1,500 professionals across 36 offices nationwide, KPFF’s decentralized structure allows each office the flexibility to pursue projects aligned with their regional strengths. Learn more at www.kpff.com.

Job Description

We’re hiring a Structural Project Manager to support and grow our Austin, Texas team. This senior-level role is ideal for a licensed structural engineer ready to lead complex building design projects, deepen client relationships, and contribute to the continued expansion of KPFF’s presence across Central Texas and surrounding markets.

At KPFF, you’ll manage vertical structure projects from concept through construction administration, mentor a talented group of engineers, and actively support business development initiatives. You’ll collaborate closely with architects, developers, owners, and contractors to deliver high-quality structural designs for commercial, residential, mixed-use, education, healthcare, and institutional projects.

As you grow with us, you’ll also have opportunities to pursue pathways to ownership, reflecting KPFF’s commitment to recognizing leadership, technical excellence, and long-term contributions.

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of being in the Austin office three days per week for collaboration, mentoring, and client meetings. While we support flexible work arrangements, this role is not fully remote. In-person presence is especially important for leadership engagement, technical mentorship, and client interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

Serve as the primary technical and client-facing lead on structural projects, ensuring strong relationships and successful delivery.
Lead project execution from schematic design through construction administration, managing schedules, budgets, quality standards, and team performance.
Oversee and review structural analysis and design for steel, concrete, wood, and masonry building systems.
Direct preparation of construction documents including calculations, drawings, specifications, and design narratives.
Coordinate closely with architects, MEP consultants, contractors, fabricators, and specialty structural reviewers.
Collaborate with teams in both Austin and San Diego, supporting projects across markets as part of our integrated reporting center structure.
Navigate Texas jurisdictional approval processes and building code compliance, including:
International Building Code (IBC) and local amendments
City of Austin Development Services Department
Special inspections and threshold building coordination
Provide construction-phase support including shop drawing review, RFIs, site observations, and field coordination.
Support business development efforts including proposals, interviews, and cultivating relationships with local clients and design partners.
Mentor and develop engineers and designers, fostering both technical excellence and leadership growth.
Represent KPFF in industry organizations and local professional groups, contributing to the visibility and reputation of the Austin team.

Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering with structural emphasis (Master’s preferred).
PE license required.
8+ years of structural engineering experience, primarily focused on building design.
Proven experience managing multi-discipline building projects and coordinating consultant teams.
Strong working knowledge of steel, concrete, wood, and masonry design.
Experience applying national codes and standards including IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, NDS, and TMS specifications.
Proficiency with structural analysis and design tools such as ETABS, RAM, RISA, SAFE, and project coordination platforms, with working familiarity drafting tools used by production teams.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience mentoring staff engineers.
Effective communicator with strong organizational and client-facing skills.
Ability to work in the Austin office at least three days per week under the hybrid work model.
Additional Information

Physical Demands

Work is primarily performed in a standard office setting with long periods of work at a computer.
Occasional lifting of items up to 15 pounds.
Visits to construction sites may involve walking, standing, climbing stairs or ladders, navigating uneven surfaces, or exposure to weather.
Local travel may be required for project meetings, observations, or client visits.

The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000 with candidates who have at least 8 years of experience, proven project management skills, and business development success. Final compensation will also consider education, licensure, and overall skills. We also provide performance-based bonuses to recognize outstanding contributions.

For those who demonstrate long-term impact and leadership, KPFF offers pathways to ownership, creating opportunities to directly share in the firm’s growth and success. During the interview process, we’ll review the full compensation package and answer any questions you may have.

Structural Project Manager - Structures Practice
Los Angeles, CA
Full Time
Los Angeles Office
Experienced

You want to run projects. Not just work on them - actually own them, lead the team, build the client relationship, and put your name on the outcome.

Our Structures Practice is looking for a Structural Engineer with the technical chops and the people skills to do exactly that. If you've spent the last few years building your craft and you're ready to step into a project leadership role across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use work - let's talk.

Who We Are

Holmes US is an international structural engineering firm with offices up and down the West Coast and a home base that goes back over 65 years to New Zealand. We're part of the Holmes Group - 500+ people worldwide - which means you get the resources and technical depth of a global firm alongside the culture and relationships of a West Coast practice where people actually know each other.

Our Structures Practice takes on the kind of work that shapes how people experience their city: university buildings, multi-family housing, civic projects, commercial developments, and seismic retrofits of the buildings already standing. The variety is intentional - it keeps the work interesting and the skill set broad.

What You'll Actually Do

Lead structural engineering projects from concept through construction administration across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use building types
Own client relationships - managing scope, schedule, budget, and expectations with clarity and consistency
Develop technically rigorous structural solutions across concrete, steel, wood, and masonry
Direct, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and designers
Drive quality control and technical reviews on your projects
Contribute to business development through strong client relationships and repeat work
Collaborate across Holmes practice areas - and, when a project calls for it, across our international offices
4-8+ years of structural engineering experience in a consultancy setting

s.h: PE license required; SE license preferred or in active pursuit
s.t:
B.S. or M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering
Seismic design experience - this is core to our practice, not a bonus
Demonstrated ability to manage projects and lead or mentor a team
Strong communication skills - you're as comfortable presenting to a client as you are reviewing calcs
Proficiency in ETABS, SAP2000, or RISA

Depending on your experience, this role will be placed at our Project Engineer or Senior Engineer level. What we're looking for in either case is someone ready to lead projects, not just contribute to them.

Why Holmes?

The breadth of our portfolio is a genuine advantage for your career. You're not going to spend five years on the same building type. You'll tackle seismic retrofits, new high-rises, school campuses, and mixed-use developments - often in the same year. That variety means you build a skill set that holds up over a long career.

We invest in our people seriously. Holmes University is our internal learning platform, giving you access to technical training and leadership development throughout your career. Senior engineers and principals here are genuinely available - mentorship isn't a line item in a brochure, it's how we actually operate. And when you need it, you have access to the technical depth of the Holmes network across New Zealand and Australia.

We also believe you follow your interests. There's a clear path to leadership and ownership at Holmes - and we'll be straight with you about what it looks like from where you're standing.

Work-Life Balance, and We Mean It

Our hybrid model is three days in the office - the rest is yours. We offer biannual profit share so you participate in the success you help create. And we've worked hard to build a culture where overtime is the exception, not the expectation. You'll do better work when you're not running on empty, and we structure the practice accordingly.

Tools: You are proficient in Google’s G-Suite, Excel, project management software (Click-up or equivalent,) CRMs, and video conferencing. ‍

A major function of the Office of Data Acquisitions is to provide databases developed from state highway safety related data for use in analyses aimed at reducing deaths, injuries, crashes, and medical costs.

As the Director, the incumbent will be responsible for the following: Advising the Associate Administrator on all matters related to the design, development, coordination, and management of crash investigation and data collection, and their contribution to achieving the mission of NHTSA.

Keeps the Associate Administrator fully informed as to the status of programs and of problems and controversial issues.

Collaborates closely with the Associate Administrator and other top officials of NHTSA to identify the agency's crash research and data needs, to determine techniques and methods by which the office can meet those needs, to estimate the cost and time required to meet the needs, and to determine other implications of changes.

Carrying out personnel management responsibilities for a staff of professional, technical, administrative and clerical support personnel. Makes decisions on work problems presented by subordinate supervisors and key specialists.

Evaluates performance of subordinate supervisors and reviews evaluations made by supervisors of subordinate employee's performance. Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the State Data Reporting Systems Division responsible for the crash record-based data.

Crash record based data includes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), a fundamental national data base on traffic safety, Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), Not-in-Traffic System (NTS) and the State Electronic Data Collection Program (SEDC)., The Division also provides the expertise in sample design and quality control to the other offices in the National Center for Statistics and Analysis, the rest of NHTSA and other offices in DOT.

Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the Crash Investigation Division (CID), provides executive leadership in the planning, design, development, coordination, and management of national networks of motor vehicle traffic crash research and data collection activities.

These include the operation of a national system to conduct detailed investigations of a well-defined selection of motor vehicle crashes currently the Crash Investigation Sampling System (CISS)); and the Special Crash Investigations (SCI) program of special investigations of crashes of particular, interest; and Systems for collecting, supplementing, and coding data from police crash reports to provide special purpose data files.

Maintaining liaison with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, police agencies, hospitals, private safety groups, motor vehicle and equipment manufacturers, crash research and analysis organizations, professional societies, and other groups with an interest in crash investigation and crash data for the purposes are for exchanging crash data and information on crash research technology, encouraging the use of crash data, and cooperating on crash research programs.

The ideal candidate is a data executive and systems expert with a track record of managing federal data collection, automation, and national crash investigation programs.

They possess the strategic and technical skills to lead multi-disciplinary teams while directing the human resource, budgetary, and procurement parameters vital to national highway safety initiatives.

A skilled collaborator, they excel at building partnerships across federal, state, and private sectors including law enforcement, public health, and the automotive industry to secure cooperation and advance data systems.

Furthermore, they bring expertise in data governance, enforcing quality control and data completeness while protecting individual privacy, ensuring the delivery of accurate databases that support national safety research and rulemaking.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications.

To qualify for the Grade 15, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-14, it must include: Experience directing multi-disciplinary professional, technical, and administrative teams while managing the organizational, human resource, and budgetary parameters vital to national highway traffic safety initiatives.

Experience communicating with system managers, rulemaking engineers, researchers, technicians, traffic safety administrators, Governor's Representatives for Highway Safety, State and local officials, national data system program managers and others associated with the application of data as it applies to helping solve complex safety issues.

Experience establishing policy and overseeing large federal data divisions to ensure data completeness, security, and rigorous quality control. Examples include working with executive leadership to plan, develop, and manage large-scale national data collection systems and multi-level crash investigation programs.

WorkWave is a leading provider of SaaS solutions, helping businesses streamline their operations and drive growth through innovative technology. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Global Professional Services team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting our Professional Services and Delivery teams by managing customer relationships, scoping billable projects, and developing clear, impactful statements of work.
Operating as a critical member of our global team, this role owns the execution of a diverse project portfolio. This role requires an adaptable leader who can seamlessly shift gears: running highly structured, complex enterprise software deployments (e.g., Time & Attendance, Payroll, Finance) while efficiently driving higher-velocity, smaller application rollouts.
This role demands an exceptional blend of professional maturity, meticulous time management across NA time zones, and the acute attention to detail required to protect project margins. You will bring structure to ambiguity, ensuring that every tier of client—from enterprise corporations to smaller accounts—experiences a world-class onboarding journey.

AI-Driven Efficiency: Champion the adoption of internal AI and automation tools to streamline project tracking, synthesize meeting data across time zones, and accelerate the creation of project documentation and status reports.
Strategic On-Site Presence : Travel domestically (up to 25%) to lead critical kick-off meetings, conduct high-stakes steering committee reviews, and foster deep, trust-based relationships with global enterprise clients and distributed teams.
Global Stakeholder Management: Establish, maintain, and navigate complex relationships with international stakeholders, delivery teams, and cross-border customers.
Scope & Detail Analysis: Define or deeply analyze project scopes, impacts, resource allocations, and localized outcomes, ensuring meticulous attention to detail before gaining customer alignment.
Precision Project Planning: Develop granular project plans, mapping out dependencies and scheduling project activities across multiple time zones.
Time Management & Execution: Rigorously track the progress of all concurrent workstreams, keeping a sharp eye on deadlines to ensure commitments are met punctually.
Transparent Communication: Deliver precise and thoroughly documented project progress updates to delivery teams, sponsors, board members, and clients.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, track, and resolve emerging risks and localized issues promptly and professionally, escalating where necessary.
Standards & Documentation: Utilize appropriate project management systems, tools, and methodologies while maintaining flawless, audit-ready project documentation.
Financial & Project Closure: Methodically close projects to enable revenue recognition, ensuring all final details are accounted for and global lessons learned are thoroughly reviewed.

Experience: 5+ years of dedicated Project Management experience, ideally managing global IT (software) and SaaS deployments.
AI Fluency: Demonstrated experience using AI-powered tools, including project management software, generative AI tools, or predictive analytics to enhance resource scheduling, risk forecasting, and stakeholder communication.
Methodology: Proven experience working within structured project management frameworks (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP).
Track Record: Documented success in delivering complex projects strictly on budget and on time, meeting or exceeding project revenue targets.
Time Management & Detail Orientation: Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, tight international deadlines, and complex project minutiae without sacrificing quality.
Communication & Negotiation : Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with a high cultural awareness for global communication.
Commercial Acumen: Demonstrable experience in commercial decision-making and managing project profitability.
Interpersonal Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills with a natural ability to quickly build trust and rapport with diverse, cross-functional, and remote international teams.
Tools & Platforms: High proficiency with modern project management tools and collaboration platforms (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheets, MS Office, G-Suite).

Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).
As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years.

This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.
You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases.

In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment.

You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.
Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.

What Do We Do?
Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.
We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.
The result: more than 65,000 brands like Pressed Juicery, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

We’re looking for an Implementation Manager, Enterprise to lead the onboarding journey for Triple Whale ’s largest and most complex customers. The role is equal parts consultative and coordinative. You’ll sit with sophisticated marketing and analytics teams to understand what they are actually trying to accomplish, then drive the people, sequencing, and detail that turn it into a live, adopted account — from contract signature through full go-live.
It is also hands-on and technical. Enterprise launches involve multiple stakeholders, custom data requirements, and real integration work — you’ll configure and validate the measurement foundation, and be accountable for the accuracy of what the customer sees on day one. You’ll also be among the first people to onboard customers onto Moby, our AI agent, teaching teams to run AI-led workflows and automations rather than just read dashboards.
You’ll set the standard of what good looks like for Enterprise onboarding works here — and mentor others on the team as we scale it.
This role is fully remote with no travel required, and must be based in the Pacific Time zone.

Lead consultative discovery with new Enterprise customers — clarify business objectives, surface constraints, and translate desired outcomes into the success criteria you drive toward during onboarding.
Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of Enterprise implementations, from kickoff through go-live and into the handoff to Customer Success — adapting how you run each onboarding to the customer’s goals, stakeholders, and technical reality while holding the timeline.
Configure and validate the technical foundation of each launch — tracking and pixel implementation, platform integrations (Shopify, Meta, Google, Klaviyo, Amazon, and more), and data source connections.
Advise on customer tech stacks and recommend integration best practices, with enough API and webhook fluency to know what is possible — and to pull in Solutions Architecture early when a launch genuinely needs custom work.
Validate attribution and data accuracy before go-live — and when something looks wrong, describe it precisely enough that Support and Product can act on it, and clearly enough that the customer knows what it means for them.
Onboard customers onto Moby, Triple Whale ’s AI agent, so teams leave onboarding running AI-led workflows and automations that make the rest of their stack smarter.
Lead training and enablement sessions that drive real adoption, pitched to both executive and practitioner audiences.
Own the handoff to Customer Success: document what was configured, what the customer is measuring, what adoption looks like at go-live, and what remains open, so the CSM starts from a real baseline rather than a blank page.
Influence the stakeholders you do not manage — build the internal champion, get the right people to show up, and move a stalled customer team without formal authority.
Apply structured risk management across your book — identify exposure early, mitigate it deliberately, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a problem.
Monitor implementation health across your entire portfolio, not just the launch in front of you.
Keep project tooling, documentation, and account records current without being reminded.
Partner proactively with Customer Success, Product, Support, and Solutions to resolve issues and unblock customers.
Mentor newer members of the Implementation team and contribute to the standards, templates, and playbooks the whole team runs on.

3–5+ years in implementation, onboarding, solutions consulting, or technical account management at a SaaS company, ideally with complex or enterprise customers.
A consultative instinct — you ask about the business problem before reaching for the configuration screen.
Strong project management skills — you plan the work, sequence dependencies, hold other people to dates you do not control, and deliver large multi-stakeholder projects on time without close supervision.
Enough technical fluency to be credible: you understand tracking and pixel implementation, integrations, APIs and webhooks well enough to explain what is happening, what it means for the customer, and what has to happen next — without needing someone to translate it for you.
Working knowledge of the martech and ecommerce stack — Shopify, Meta and Google Ads, email and SMS platforms — and how attribution actually behaves across them.
The ability to balance technical depth with clarity: you can go deep with an engineer, then explain the same thing to a CMO without losing either of them.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders you have no authority over — you can run the room, push back on a plan that will not work, and keep an executive sponsor engaged.
Disciplined risk management: you spot exposure early and act on it rather than reporting it.
Curiosity about AI and a willingness to teach customers a new way of working, not just a new piece of software.
Knowledge of retail and eCommerce business needs, processes, and best practices.
An interest in mentoring and raising the bar for the team, not just running your own book.

Previous experience in SaaS, MarTech, analytics, or eCommerce platforms.
Background in customer success, account management, or professional services.

The Strategic Sourcing Manager is responsible for shaping and executing strategic sourcing activities across VAT-s global Packaging category and selected Professional Services, IT and other indirect categories.

The role develops sourcing and supplier strategies based on spend, market, cost and risk analysis and leads initiatives from opportunity identification through sourcing, negotiation, contracting and implementation.

Working as a strategic partner to global stakeholders, the position drives sustainable business value through improved total cost, supplier performance, resilience, commercial value and risk management.

* Develop and lead strategic sourcing initiatives across Packaging, Professional Services, IT and other assigned categories.
* Analyze spend, demand, supplier markets, cost drivers and risks to identify and prioritize value opportunities.

* Lead complex commercial negotiations and develop effective commercial and contractual solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and Legal.
* Evaluate and develop strategic suppliers and drive supplier performance, consolidation and relationship optimization where appropriate.
* Develop and implement sourcing and supply-risk mitigation strategies, including supplier diversification and alternative sourcing approaches.
* Translate business requirements into effective sourcing solutions, challenge requirements where appropriate and drive cross-functional decisions through influence rather than direct authority.
* Partner with senior stakeholders across Operations, IT, HR, Finance, Legal, Business Units and Procurement globally to align sourcing outcomes with business objectives.
* Ensure measurable value realization through savings, cost avoidance, improved total cost of ownership, supplier performance, commercial improvements and risk reduction.

* 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing and/or category management, preferably in a global industrial, manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
* Proven experience in Packaging procurement or strategic sourcing, with a strong understanding of supplier markets, cost drivers, specifications and commercial models.
* Proven track record of developing and leading strategic sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification through implementation and value realization.
* Strong experience in strategic and commercial negotiations, supplier strategy and supplier performance management.
* Experience working with global or multi-site supplier markets and across functions, regions and business units in a complex matrix organization.
* Strong analytical capabilities, including spend analysis, benchmarking, cost-driver analysis and total-cost considerations.
* Experience with Professional Services, IT or other complex indirect categories is advantageous.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge requirements and drive alignment without formal authority.
* Strategic and commercial mindset combined with a pragmatic, results-oriented approach and strong ownership for outcomes.
* Fluency in German and English.
* Experience with ERP, eSourcing or procurement platforms is advantageous.

* **Visible business impact:** Lead global sourcing initiatives with a direct impact on cost, supplier performance, supply resilience and VAT-s competitiveness.

The Manager partners closely with Field Sales, Market Access, and Patient Services to ensure seamless navigation of retail prior authorizations (PA), pharmacy benefit processes, and access pathways

· Guide the team in effective virtual engagement techniques, including platform use, presentation skills, and efficient troubleshooting.

· Oversee consistent and accurate CRM documentation, ensuring data quality, completeness, and insights that drive access strategy.

· Proven leadership experience managing remote or field-based teams.

You will work closely with architects and engineers and develop a strong understanding of customer environments and Nebius cloud infrastructure. This role is remote within the United States and requires candidates to be based on the East Coast.

# Manager:in digitale Kanäle 80 - 100% #
Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis
### Unser Angebot ###
* Eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem motivierten Team
* Gelebte flache Hierarchien und flexible Home-Office-Regelungen
* Spannende Einblicke in die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten unserer Einheiten
* Ein Arbeitsort direkt am Hauptbahnhof
* Die Stelle ist in Lohnklasse 20 eingereiht (Informationen zum Lohnsystem).

## Projektleitung Pionierprojekt - Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung ##
### 30% vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase vom 1. Januar bis 31. Dezember 2027. ###
Du möchtest Kindern in hoch belasteten Lebenslagen, für die es bisher kaum passende Wohnformen gibt, einen sicheren Lebensort ermöglichen?
Wirke mit am Aufbau eines neuen, familiären und traumapädagogischen Angebots im Kanton Luzern!
Ausgangslage
Die Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung Luzern und Subito Kriseninterventionen entwickeln im Auftrag des Kantons Luzern ein neues traumapädagogisches, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot.

Das Angebot richtet sich an Kinder, Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene bis maximal 25 Jahre mit stark belastenden Bindungs- und Beziehungserfahrungen sowie herausfordernden Verhaltensweisen, für die bestehende stationäre Wohnformen oder Pflegeverhältnisse nicht ausreichend tragfähig sind.

Ziel ist es, dass die Kinder und Jugendlichen im Zuhause eines Menschen mit Ausbildung im Sozialbereich leben, der diese Aufgabe als Haupterwerb übernimmt und zusätzliche Unterstützung von weiteren Menschen aus dem eigenen sowie professionellen Umfeld erhält.
Die erste Projektphase vom 1. Januar 2027 bis 31. Dezember 2027 dient dazu, die fachlichen und organisatorischen Grundlagen sorgfältig zu entwickeln und die Umsetzung ab 2028 vorzubereiten. Dafür suchen wir eine initiative, verbindende und fachlich starke Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, Neues aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und traumapädagogisches Wissen wirksam in die Praxis zu übersetzen.
### Funktion ###
Projektleitung Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung
### Pensum ###
30 %
### Dauer ###
Vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2027. Es besteht die Option einer Verlängerung bei Abschluss der ersten Projektphase.
### Projektziel ###
Aufbau des neuen Angebots: Erarbeitung von Konzept und Kooperationsgrundlagen, Rekrutierung und Anstellung von Betreuungspersonen, allgemeine Vorbereitung der Leistungserbringung, Zusammenarbeit mit externen Anspruchsgruppen aufbauen
### Arbeitsfeld ###
Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Traumapädagogik, Pflegekinderwesen, stationäre Intensivbetreuung im familiären Umfeld
Deine Aufgabe
In der Rolle Projektleitung gestaltest du die Aufbauarbeit eines innovativen Angebots mit hoher fachlicher und gesellschaftlicher Bedeutung. Du entwickelst tragfähige Grundlagen, steuerst den Projektprozess, vernetzt zentrale Partnerinnen und Partner und bringst traumapädagogische Expertise so ein, dass ab 2028 ein wirksames, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot starten kann.
Deine Hauptaufgaben konkret
* Aufbau der Projektorganisation mit den beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung und Subito Kriseninterventionen und weiteren relevanten Anspruchsgruppen inkl. Leitung eines Projektteams
* Entwicklung des Konzepts für die traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung unter punktuellem Einbezug externer traumapädagogischer Expertise und in Zusammenarbeit mit den zukünftigen Betreuungspersonen
* Definition der Aufnahme- und Ausschlusskriterien sowie der konkreten Leistungsinhalte
* Erarbeitung einer tragfähigen Lösung für die Tagesstruktur, falls vorübergehend kein Schulplatz vorhanden ist
* Aufbau der Zusammenarbeit mit der Luzerner Psychiatrie und Erarbeitung einer Kooperationsvereinbarung
* Ausarbeitung der Stellenbeschriebe und Rekrutierung des künftigen Betreuungspersonals, gewünscht ist eine frühzeitige Einbindung der hauptbetreuenden Person in die Konzeptentwicklung
* Vorbereitung der Arbeitsverträge und weiterer Anstellungsunterlagen für Betreuungspersonen unter Einbezug juristischer Expertise
* Aufgleisung der fachlichen Unterstützung für die Betreuungspersonen, insbesondere Gruppensupervision
* Bekanntmachung des Projekts bei wichtigen zuweisenden Stellen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Leitungen der beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen
* Entwicklung von Instrumenten für die Auswertung der zweiten Pilotprojektphase sowie einer Struktur für den ausführlichen Zwischenbericht
* Erstellung des Berichts zur ersten Projektphase zuhanden der DISG/KOSEG inklusive Zustellung des Konzepts für das Leistungsangebot
Das bringst du mit
Wir suchen eine reflektierte, mutige und verbindende Persönlichkeit, die Freude und Leidenschaft für innovative Pionierarbeit mitbringt. Besonders relevant für diese Aufgabe sind:
* Ausbildung in Sozialer Arbeit, Sozialpädagogik, Heilpädagogik, Psychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, idealerweise im stationären Bereich oder im Pflegekinderwesen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Traumapädagogik, Bindungstheorie und traumasensibler Beziehungsgestaltung
* Erfahrung in Projektleitung, Konzeptentwicklung und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
* Bereitschaft zu einer gleichwertigen Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und Freude an partizipativen Entscheidungs- und Arbeitsformaten
* Sicherheit und Eigenständigkeit im schriftlichen Arbeiten, in der Berichterstattung, im Umgang mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln und im Aufbau fachlicher Grundlagen
* Hohe Selbständigkeit, eine sehr gute Arbeitsorganisation und Freude daran, aus Ideen konkrete nächste Schritte zu entwickeln
* Kommunikationsstärke, Vernetzungsfähigkeit und die Gabe, unterschiedliche Akteurinnen und Akteure konstruktiv einzubinden
Das bieten wir
* Eine sinnstiftende Projektaufgabe mit grosser fachlicher, gesellschaftlicher und menschlicher Relevanz
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und eine hohe fachliche Autonomie beim Aufbau eines neuen kantonalen Pilotangebots
* Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Organisationen und Fachpersonen der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Fachlichen Austausch mit traumapädagogischer Expertise
* Sehr flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Rahmen des Projektauftrags
* Die Möglichkeit, Grundlagen für ein spezialisiertes Angebot mit nachhaltiger Wirkung zu schaffen
* Option auf längerfristige Rolle bei erfolgreicher Pilotphase
Worum es im Angebot geht
Im Zentrum des künftigen Angebots steht eine bewährte Idee aus dem nahen Ausland: Eine sozialpädagogische Fachperson stellt ihr eigenes Zuhause für die längerfristige Betreuung eines Kindes zur Verfügung und wird dafür in einem 100-Prozent-Pensum angestellt.

Sie wird von Menschen aus ihrem persönlichen Umfeld sowie von professionellen Unterstützungspersonen begleitet und entlastet. So entsteht ein tragfähiges Netz rund um das Kind und die betreuende Fachperson. Das Angebot verbindet Kontinuität, verlässliche Beziehungen, Schutz, Partizipation und traumasensible Begleitung.

Kinder und Jugendliche sollen einen äusseren und personalen sicheren Ort erleben, korrigierende Beziehungserfahrungen machen und gemeinsam mit Fachpersonen neue Handlungsroutinen entwickeln können.
Stellenantritt und weiteres Vorgehen
Der Stellenantritt ist per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung vorgesehen.

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers.

Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
The Senior Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of Zayo's long haul fiber deployment portfolio through direct oversight of turnkey engineering and construction partners, cross-functional leadership, and governance of multiple concurrent, large-scale infrastructure programs. This role provides both strategic direction and operational execution across complex, multi-million-dollar network expansion initiatives.
The Senior Program Manager owns program governance, capital planning, contractor strategy, executive stakeholder alignment, risk management, and portfolio performance while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.
Serving as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, engineering and construction partners, customers, and executive leadership, this position drives organizational alignment across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, GIS, and Network Planning to deliver critical network infrastructure at scale.
This role also leads continuous improvement initiatives, establishes deployment best practices, mentors program managers, and influences long-term deployment strategy across the Long Haul organization.
The Senior Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.

Strategic Program Leadership
Own a portfolio of large-scale long haul deployment programs supporting strategic network expansion initiatives.
Develop portfolio delivery strategies aligned with company growth objectives and capital investment priorities.
Lead cross-functional planning from business case development through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, customer acceptance, and operational turnover.
Establish program governance, delivery standards, performance metrics, and executive reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Balance competing priorities, resources, and funding across multiple programs to optimize delivery performance.
Identify portfolio-level risks and dependencies and proactively implement mitigation and recovery strategies.
Provide recommendations to senior leadership regarding delivery strategy, capital allocation, contractor utilization, and execution priorities.
Executive Stakeholder Leadership
Serve as the executive operational lead for assigned deployment programs.
Build trusted relationships with executive leadership, customers, regulatory agencies, and strategic construction partners.
Lead executive steering committees, program reviews, and customer governance meetings.
Influence cross-functional decision making across Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Network Planning.
Drive alignment between business objectives and deployment execution across multiple organizations.
Contractor Strategy & Vendor Performance
Develop long-term strategic relationships with turnkey engineering and construction partners.
Lead commercial negotiations for engineering and construction agreements, amendments, and complex change orders.
Establish contractor performance scorecards, KPIs, governance processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Evaluate contractor capacity, financial performance, safety metrics, production trends, and quality performance.
Drive executive-level performance reviews and corrective action plans when contractor performance falls below expectations.
Partner with Procurement and Legal to optimize sourcing strategies and improve contractor performance across the deployment portfolio.
Portfolio Financial Management
Own portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, and financial performance.
Manage multi-million-dollar capital budgets across numerous concurrent deployment programs.
Lead financial forecasting, variance analysis, accrual management, and executive reporting.
Evaluate commercial impacts of scope changes, schedule adjustments, and risk events.
Partner with Finance to improve forecasting accuracy and optimize capital deployment.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, operational efficiencies, and improved return on investment.
Engineering, Regulatory & Deployment Governance
Provide strategic oversight of engineering, permitting, regulatory compliance, and construction execution.
Partner with Engineering leadership to improve constructability, deployment standards, and network design efficiency.
Oversee compliance with federal, state, and local regulatory requirements including NTIA, NEPA, Section 106, Tribal coordination, Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental obligations.
Ensure governance processes support quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and customer commitments across all assigned programs.
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Lead initiatives to improve deployment processes, governance, reporting, and execution methodologies.
Develop standardized program management tools, dashboards, KPIs, and best practices.
Identify systemic risks and implement scalable operational improvements.
Leverage program data and performance metrics to improve forecasting accuracy, contractor productivity, and deployment efficiency.
Drive lessons learned across the organization to continuously improve delivery performance.
Leadership & Talent Development
Mentor and develop Program Managers, Project Managers, and deployment personnel.
Provide guidance on complex delivery challenges, contractor management, financial controls, and executive communication.
Lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.
Support organizational planning, succession development, and capability building within the Long Haul Deployment organization.

Experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, Business, or related field preferred.
Equivalent industry experience may be substituted for formal education.
At least ten (10) years of telecommunications, fiber deployment, infrastructure, or OSP program management experience.
At least eight (8) years leading complex outside plant construction programs and contractor organizations.
Demonstrated success leading portfolios of multimillion-dollar infrastructure deployments.
Experience managing EPC, engineering, and construction contracts.
Experience managing federally funded broadband programs and associated regulatory compliance.
Experience leading cross-functional organizations through complex delivery challenges.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. As Elastic expands into increasingly complex offerings, the path from idea to launched monetized product requires heavy cross-functional coordination. You’ll be a key strategic partner to our Product organization, owning the operational end-to-end of Pricing and Packaging.
Cross Functional Influence: Drive alignment across the stakeholders required to launch a pricing or packaging change, including FP&A, Revenue, Legal, IT, and Billing. Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance .
That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination?

To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
What you'll be doing
As our Senior Strategic Project Manager within the Office of the CEO, you will be a primary execution driver behind our most critical cross-functional initiatives. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting executive leadership with operational, regulatory, product, and business teams across our Luxembourg and Milan hubs.
While you will work side-by-side with internal Legal, Compliance, and Risk experts who own the regulatory subject matter, your core strength is senior strategic leadership and project execution: acting as a key leader within the organization to orchestrate complex initiatives across different verticals, driving high-impact project timelines, and turning corporate obligations into seamless operational workflows.

s.h: Here's what that looks like in practice
s.t:
Solve complex business challenges - Tackling intricate business problems by developing innovative, data-backed solutions with a consistent user-first approach.
Stakeholder management and strategic partnership - Managing relationships with C-level stakeholders and acting as a thought partner for leadership on specific strategic areas.
Strategic influence - Influencing major decisions through in-depth analysis and proven insights, integrating diverse perspectives into coherent strategies.
Champion methodology and best practices - Developing and introducing new methodologies, best practices, or frameworks within the team or company, ensuring a consistent user-first approach.
Champion Regulatory Requirements in Roadmap Design - Act as the project manager champion for what regulatory and supervisory requirements apply to a given initiative, ensuring they are proactively factored into project roadmaps at the design stage - partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk.
Govern & Monitor Multi-Hub Projects - Establish project governance, track milestones across offices, proactively remove cross-departmental bottlenecks, mitigate delivery risks, and provide crisp, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.
Anchor Luxembourg Operational Synergies - Serve as an authoritative on-the-ground project leader in Luxembourg, ensuring that financial institution governance requirements seamlessly harmonize with Satispay’s group-wide strategy and product velocity.

This role needs someone who is a problem-solver that loves teamwork, gets things done, and is ready for real ownership across regulated financial environments.
Experience - Minimum 6–7 years of hands-on experience within a regulated environment -ideally within high-growth Fintech, Scale-ups, EMI/Banking institutions, or Financial Services.
Regulatory Expertise - Hands-on knowledge and deep familiarity with compliance, legal, and regulatory matters.
Master Project Operator - Proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end multi-stakeholder initiatives using structured project management frameworks.
Fintech & EMI Licensing Awareness - Good high-level familiarity with the fintech landscape, EMI/payment institution dynamics, and European financial regulation concepts (PSD2/PSD3, AML/CFT, GDPR) — enough to translate requirements into project delivery without needing to be the legal specialist yourself.
Cross-Border Leadership - Demonstrated ability to build consensus, establish momentum, and align priorities across distributed international offices and matrixed teams.
Executive Presence - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to synthesize technical, operational, and regulatory concepts into clear, executive-level narratives and actionable plans.
Mobility - Based in Luxembourg with a willingness for frequent, hands-on collaboration travel to our Milan headquarters.
Languages - Fluent in English (written and spoken). Italian is a strong asset.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

s.h: CareAbout: how we support your impact
s.t: We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

RBAC (Role-Based): Access granted based on job functions (e.g., "HR Manager").

Administration (Lifecycle Management): Managing the full lifespan of a digital identity, from provisioning (creation) and maintenance (role changes) to deprovisioning (deletion when a user leaves). Auditing & Reporting (Accountability): Tracking and recording user activities to maintain a clear audit trail.

A. Technical Administration Within assigned technical program, assures on a continuing basis: organizations are organized, staffed, equipped, conduct training program, acceptable record keeping system, facilities and procedures that meet all regulatory requirements.

Regularly visits organization's stations and other offices to maintain contact with management officials; coordinates with the Principal Inspector for correction of any deficiencies/discrepancies. Develops maintenance program requirements for engines and APUs through participation on Maintenance Review Boards.

Coordinates (MEL}; engines for approval with Principal Operations Inspector. Takes enforcement action of noncompliance with the MEL. Conducts enforcement investigations, prepares final reports, and recommendations on disposition. Performs or supervises emergency suspension of certificates or cancellations of operations specifications.

Conducts/directs the re-examination of certificated airmen, recertification of an operator, or agency. Conducts investigations of public complaints, congressional inquiries, aircraft incidents, and accidents. Provides verbal and/or written technical assistance to legal counsel, testifies at court trials, formal hearings, and gives depositions.

Coordinates with geographic inspectors for accomplishment of non-routine air carrier surveillance. B. Certification Responsible for initial ongoing certification of engines and APUs for air carriers, aircraft, air agencies, and initial/ongoing certification of airmen. Makes recommendations on appointment of designees.

Evaluates requests not previously specified in maintenance portion of operations specifications, approves/disapproves requests, provides additional conditions and limitations as needed. Provides guidance to assigned air carrier in development of required engine, APU maintenance manuals, and record keeping systems.

Reviews and determines adequacy of engine manuals associated with air carrier¿s engine, APU maintenance programs and revisions thereto. Assures that manuals and revisions comply with regulatory requirements, prescribes safe practices; furnishes clear and specific instructions governing engine and APU maintenance programs.

Approves operations specifications and amendments thereto. Determines if engine and APU maintenance facilities being established or contract arrangements entered into by air carriers for purpose of overhaul work, major repair, alterations, and other maintenance are satisfactory.

Reviews changes and negotiates with air carrier management to resolve problems. Determines if engine and APU overhaul and inspection time limitations warrant revision. Evaluates operator's proposed engine and APU reliability programs for compliance with national policies. Advises operator of deficiencies and required changes.

Approves/disapproves engine and APU reliability programs. Determines if air carrier's training program meets requirements of CFRs, is compatible with engine and APU maintenance program, is properly organized and effectively conducted, and results in trained and competent personnel.

Directs or participates in proving flight evaluations to determine compliance with CFRs. Recommends changes that will be required prior to approval. C. Surveillance Directs and/or performs inspection and surveillance of air carrier's continuous airworthiness engine and APU maintenance program.

Analyzes trends to detect a deterioration in the engine and APU maintenance program. Analyzes engine and APU reports submitted by air carrier to ensure compliance with maintenance program; assures air carrier has an effective continuing analysis and surveillance program to meet requirements of CFR's.

Monitors: air operators, agencies, designees: in addition all phases of air carrier's engine and APU maintenance operation, including the following: engine and APU maintenance, engineering, quality control, production control, training, and reliability programs.
General Requirements for All Positions: Not more than two separate incidents involving Federal aviation regulations violations in the last 5 years; Valid State driver's license; Fluency in the English language; No chemical dependencies or drug abuse that could interfere with job performance; and High school diploma or equivalent.

Medical Requirements for All Positions: Applicants must be physically able to perform the duties of the Aviation Safety Inspector position in a safe and efficient manner, and must meet all of the following requirements: Have good distant vision in each eye and be able to read printed materials the size of typewritten characters (glasses and contact lenses permitted) without strain; Have the ability to hear the conversational voice (hearing aid permitted); Not have any physical condition that would cause them to be a hazard to themselves or others or that would interfere with their ability to fly as passengers in a variety of aircraft.

When the predominant work involves air carrier maintenance applicants for Aviation Safety Inspector (Maintenance) positions must meet all of the following requirements: Experience involving the maintenance and repair of airframes, power plants, and systems of multi-engine aircraft of more than 12,500 pounds maximum certificated takeoff weight maintained under an airworthiness maintenance and inspection program.

Aircraft maintenance experience in a repair station; air carrier or airline repair facility; military repair facility; or local, state, or Federal governmental agency. Experience involving the maintenance and repair of airframes, power plants, and aircraft systems with responsibility for certifying airworthiness.

Aircraft maintenance work experience within the last 3 years. FAA Mechanic Certificate with airframe and power plant ratings. Specialized Experience: To qualify for this position you must demonstrate in your application that you possess at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the FV-I, FG/GS-13 level.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position.

Specialized Experience includes: Maintenance experience on 14 CFR part 121 aircraft and associated components; Evaluating and deciding upon proposals to change the authorized programs of organizations; Monitoring, planning or conducting inspection programs; assures that assigned organizations are properly and adequately organized, staffed, and equipped; have and conduct an adequate training program, including an acceptable record keeping system; and have facilities and procedures that meet all regulatory requirements, Conducting enforcement investigations and preparing of final reports and recommendations on disposition.

Plan and organize the software release schedule and coordinate the release with the engineering teams.

Define overarching metrics for the performance of our release quality, monitoring and testing tools.
Proactively improve or create processes to improve the reliability, quality, or execution speed of our firmware releases.

You have 3+ years experience in project management within a technical environment.

You enjoy working independently and autonomously in your day-to-day.

At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.
In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.
We’re looking for someone who combines the mindset of a consultant, the discipline of a strong program leader and operator, and a genuine passion for creating a great employee experience.
This role is for someone who is naturally curious about how things work—and how they could work better. You’ll look across employee feedback, processes, systems, and stakeholder experiences to identify friction, diagnose root causes, and design thoughtful, scalable solutions.
Initially, you’ll focus on three critical areas of the employee lifecycle: onboarding, employee listening, and engagement. You’ll partner closely with teams across People, Talent Acquisition, IT, Workplace, and the business to understand needs, bring structure to complex or ambiguous problems, and improve the experiences employees and managers have at Algolia.
You won’t just execute existing processes. You’ll help shape the strategy behind them, lead programs from discovery through implementation, and continuously ask: What problem are we trying to solve? What are employees actually experiencing? Where is friction showing up? What does the data tell us? And how can we create something that works better for both employees and the business?
Success in this role means creating employee experiences that feel thoughtful, human, and connected while building the structure, processes, and operating discipline needed to make those experiences scalable and sustainable.

Employee Listening & Insights
Own the execution and evolution of Algolia’s employee listening strategy, including engagement, pulse, onboarding, exit, and other lifecycle surveys.
Turn employee feedback into meaningful insights by identifying trends, themes, risks, and opportunities.
Combine quantitative data with qualitative feedback to understand what is happening and why.
Develop clear narratives and recommendations that help leaders move from data to action.
Partner with leaders and People Business Partners to understand what sits behind the data and determine where deeper discovery may be needed.
Create reporting, communications, action-planning resources, and follow-up mechanisms that make employee feedback useful—not simply informational.
Establish thoughtful processes that create a consistent and scalable approach to employee listening.
Evaluate the effectiveness of listening programs and continuously improve how we collect, interpret, and act on feedback.
Onboarding Experience
Own and continuously improve the end-to-end onboarding experience, from pre-boarding through the first 90 days.
Assess the new hire journey across systems, communications, learning, manager touchpoints, community, and workplace experiences to identify friction and opportunities.
Partner across Talent Acquisition, People Operations, IT, Workplace, Learning & Development, and business teams to create a coordinated experience.
Use onboarding feedback, operational metrics, stakeholder input, and employee insights to prioritize improvements.
Design experiences that help new hires build clarity, connection, confidence, and productivity more quickly.
Establish clear ownership and workflows across the many teams involved in onboarding.
Identify opportunities to simplify and automate onboarding processes without losing the human moments that matter.
Design Better Processes and Experiences
Evaluate existing employee experience processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, redesign, or automate them.
Conduct discovery with employees, managers, and stakeholders to understand needs, pain points, and lived experiences before designing solutions.
Build clear, scalable workflows with defined ownership, decision points, handoffs, documentation, and measures of success.
Balance employee needs, business requirements, and operational realities when designing solutions.
Translate strategy into practical execution plans while maintaining a strong focus on the employee experience.
Build feedback loops into programs so employee and stakeholder input continuously informs how experiences evolve.
Establish mechanisms for continuously evaluating whether programs and processes are delivering the intended experience.

A deeply employee-centered mindset, with strong empathy, active listening skills, and curiosity about how processes, systems, communications, and decisions are experienced by employees.
A process-oriented mindset with experience designing, improving, and operationalizing workflows and programs.
Strong program and project management skills, including the ability to define scope, prioritize work, manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder accountability.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take an ambiguous challenge, diagnose root causes, and create a structured path forward.
Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to combine quantitative data with qualitative insights to identify patterns and make recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear insights, recommendations, and decisions.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including the ability to build trust, navigate competing perspectives, and influence without authority.
A continuous improvement mindset and curiosity about how technology, AI, and automation can make work both more efficient and more human.
Comfort operating in environments where the answer or process may not yet exist.

Experience in creating people strategy and an eagerness to improve employee engagement, connection & belonging
Experience with employee listening, onboarding, engagement, or lifecycle programs.
Experience leading initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, perspectives and priorities
Experience with Lattice, Seismic, or similar tools
Experience supporting global or distributed organizations
Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools and workflow automation
What Success Looks Like

s.h: Within your first year, you will
s.t:
Become a trusted thought partner who helps the People team diagnose employee experience challenges and turn them into practical solutions.
Deliver employee experience programs with strong project discipline, clear ownership, effective stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
Build a more consistent, intentional, and measurable onboarding experience that improves new hire clarity, connection, readiness, and engagement.
Establish an employee listening approach that moves beyond reporting results to generating insights and driving meaningful action.
